versions.changelog:
- Added metadata block to SKILL.md, detailing required environment variables, credentials, and local storage paths.
- Specified that the skill uses only the Spotify API and stores OAuth tokens locally.
- No changes to code or core functionality.

Initial release of Spotify Intelligence stack.

- Establishes explicit, environment-driven configuration with secrets kept out of repo files.
- Standardizes logging and error payloads for debugging future modules.
- Lays out a modular architecture for OAuth authentication, playback control, local music journaling, and explainable mood-based recommendations.
- Provides comprehensive reference documentation for all planned modules and workflows.
